headline: MERZ 🗣️ RAIDS AfD 🐺 in STORMY 🌩️ Debate after Far-Right ELECTION 🗳️ WIN
text:
MERZ 🧔 and WEIDEL 👩‍💼 faced OFF ⚔️ for the FIRST 🥇 time since SUNDAY'S 🌞 AfD election VICTORY 🏆 in a BUNDESTAG 🏛️ showdown that left EVERYONE 🫂 DRIPPING 💧 with political TENSION 🥊!! German CHANCELLOR 👔 Friedrich Merz absolutely COOKED 🍳 the anti-immigration PARTY 🎉 by calling them a DESTRUCTIVE 💥 FORCE 🦸 with a migration POLICY 📜 that basically equals ETHNIC 🧬 CLEANSING 🧹 for skilled WORKERS 🛠️ after their SWEEPING 🧹 victory in SAXONY-ANHALT 🗺️ where they SNAGGED 🥅 almost 44% 📈 of the VOTE 🗳️ while Merz's CONSERVATIVES 🛡️ watched their own support get HALVED ✂️ like a bad HAIRCUT ✂️!!

WEIDEL 👠 told the MPS 🧑‍⚖️ that VOTERS 🗳️ had shown Merz's COALITION 🤝 with the centre LEFT ⬅️ was a TOTAL 💯 FAILURE ❌ and his TIME ⏰ was UP ☝️ but Merz HIT 🥊 back HARD 🪨 saying the AfD had HARMED 🤕 German INTERESTS 🇩🇪 by backing RUSSIA 🇷🇺 and its REMIGRATION 🚪 POLICY would affect MILLIONS 🧮 of people including one in SIX 6️⃣ skilled WORKERS 🧰 who have a MIGRATION 🌍 background which would turn into nothing OTHER 🔄 than a SYNONYM 📖 for ethnic CLEANSING 🧼 based on SKIN 🧴 colour and ORIGIN 🧬!! The BUNDESTAG PRESIDENT 🪑 Julia Klöckner even had to THREATEN ⚠️ expelling people from the CHAMBER 🪑 because the AfD MPs were HECKLING 📢 so LOUD 🔊 it sounded like a FOOTBALL � soccer pitch 🏟️!!

MERZ 🧔 admitted the SEISMIC 🌋 result has CHANGED 🔄 Germany FOREVER ♾️ since no far-right PARTY 🐘 has won POWER 💪 in any of the 16 STATES 🗺️ since WORLD WAR 🪖 TWO 2️⃣ and it is still not CLEAR ❓ whether they can even FORM 🧱 a government in SAXONY-ANHALT 🏰 after falling THREE 3️⃣ seats SHORT 📏 of an outright MAJORITY 🏅!! The AfD's SUCCESS 🏆 has been PRAISED 🙌 by US PRESIDENT 🇺🇸 Donald Trump who said the POPULIST 🗣️ Party in Germany just had a really BIG 🐘 night linking the victory directly to HORRIBLE 😣 immigration RULES 📜 and regulations that are absolutely TRASH 🗑️!!

WEIDEL 👩‍💼 opened the SESSION 🪑 by claiming Merz's CHRISTIAN DEMOCRATS ✝️ had been PULVERISED 💥 in Saxony-Anhalt after scraping only 17.2% 📉 and she accused his GOVERNMENT 🏛️ with the Social Democrats of driving the whole COUNTRY 🇩🇪 towards BANKRUPTCY 💸 while Merz fired BACK 🔙 that her party had NOT ❌ won an outright majority and never WILL 🛑 achieve one across GERMANY 🇩🇪!! He called them a DESTRUCTIVE 💣 FORCE that was CHEATING 🤥 the voters by saying before the ELECTION 🗳️ their candidate Ulrich Siegmund would only RULE 👑 with a full majority but then HOURS 🕒 later decided to go HUNTING 🔎 for coalition PARTNERS 👫 anyway opening the door to maybe teaming up with the left-wing POPULIST BSW 🧩 as long as they back Siegmund to become state PREMIER 👔!!

THE 🏛️ AfD in Saxony-Anhalt has been LABELLED 🏷️ as right-wing EXTREMIST 🦹 by German domestic INTELLIGENCE 🕵️ and they have promised a full DEPORTATION ✈️ and REMIGRATION 🚪 offensive targeting irregular MIGRANTS 🌍 while Merz stressed the government understands some DEPORTATIONS 🛫 are needed but makes a careful DISTINCTION ⚖️ between those who CONTRIBUTE 💰 to German PROSPERITY 🌟 and those without permanent RESIDENCY 🏠!! Weidel claimed mass MIGRATION 🌊 had left Germans facing daily KNIFE 🔪 violence and attacks on TRAINS 🚄 and in STATIONS 🚉 but Merz warned that the AfD plans would mean no single CARE 🏥 home hospital or RESTAURANT 🍽️ could even FUNCTION 🏗️ anymore which is why he keeps the so-called FIREWALL 🧱 firmly in PLACE 🛑 so no mainstream party will work with the far RIGHT ➡️!!

TRUMP 🧑‍💼 had been due to speak by PHONE 📞 to the German chancellor on WEDNESDAY 📅 to mark the 25th ANNIVERSARY 🎂 of the 9/11 attacks but the call got POSTPONED ⏳ without any explanation from the Berlin government SPOKESMAN 🗣️ and no new DATE 📆 has been set yet leaving everyone wondering if the seismic AfD WIN 🏆 threw a massive WRENCH 🔧 into the TRANSATLANTIC 🤝 relationship while Merz continues to SLAM 🚪 the far-right as a force that will ultimately HARM 🩹 Germany's core INTERESTS 🏛️!!
